Australian PM Defends Late Mother Against Politician's Remarks

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese became emotional while defending his late mother, Mary Albanese, against remarks made by politician Pauline Hanson. Hanson reportedly stated that Albanese's mother was "way out of her league." Albanese, visibly moved, responded by stating his mother was a "strong woman" and a "good woman." He defended her character and legacy in the face of the comments.
